home.title: Find your people. Explore Bangladesh.
home.subtitle: Join small-group trips hosted by verified locals, see exactly where your money goes, and travel with safety built in.
home.destinationsSubtitle: From cloud-wrapped hills to the longest beach on earth. Every destination shows its live safety status.
home.tripsSubtitle: Small groups, transparent costs, real hosts.

find.title: Find a trip
find.body: Filter by destination, date, budget and the kind of group you want to travel with.

request.title: Request to join
request.body: Hosts see who is coming before they accept, so every group is one you can trust.

pay.title: Pay into escrow
pay.body: Your money is held safely and released to the host in stages, never all at once.

travel.title: Travel and review
travel.body: Chat with your group, check in on the road, and review the trip when you are home.

home.safetySubtitle: Everything on Ghurify is built around getting you there and back safely.

verified.title: Verified hosts
verified.body: Hosts verify their national ID before they can publish a trip.

escrow.title: Escrow payments
escrow.body: Refunds are automatic if a trip is cancelled or a destination closes.

sos.title: SOS and check-ins
sos.body: One tap shares your live location with the safety desk and your contacts.

women.title: Women-only trips
women.body: Led by verified women hosts, with women-only rooms.

alerts.title: Closure alerts
alerts.body: Weather and closure warnings reach every traveller on an affected trip.

home.ctaBody: Hosting opens soon for verified locals. Sign in today and be first in line.

welcome.title: Welcome to Ghurify
welcome.body: Ghurify connects travellers with trusted hosts for small-group trips across Bangladesh. This one-minute tour shows you around.

search.title: Search for a trip
search.body: Pick a destination, a date and the kind of group you want to travel with.

destinations.title: Explore destinations
destinations.body: Each destination shows its live safety status. Caution and closure notices come straight from the safety desk.

trips.title: Join a group trip
trips.body: Every trip shows seats left, the day-by-day plan and exactly where your money goes, before you commit.

safety.title: Safety comes first
safety.body: Verified hosts, escrow payments, SOS check-ins and women-only trips.

language.title: Bangla or English
language.body: Switch the language at any time. Your choice is remembered.
